description: Make a group of people, rename it, change its description, or delete it. 'group' names it (its name, any case, or its id); a name the company has no group by makes one. 'rename' gives an existing group a new name; 'delete': true removes it — its members, its places on projects and its grants go with it; refused while a page restriction still names it, since that page would open to everybody. Groups do not nest. The company's administrator only; every change is in the company's journal.

description.description: What the group is for, up to 500 characters; an empty string clears it.

group.description: The group's name, e.g. 'Accounting', or its id.

rename.description: A new name for an existing group.

name: set_user_group
title: Set user group
